item.title: Coke's Struggle to Break Into the $500 Billion Global Coffee Market
item.description: Coca-Cola’s acquisition of Costa Coffee was supposed to lead to thousands of self-serve espresso machines around the world. Instead, Coke got burned. Kristina Peterson reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Indonesia’s Top Stocks Face Outsized Selling, Says Allspring
item.description: Indonesian banks and telecommunication stocks may face further losses, as the nation’s best-run companies struggle to stay immune from any broad selloff on the risk of a downgrade by MSCI Inc., according to Allspring Global Investments.

item.title: Merdeka Gold Braves Indonesia Turmoil With $559 Million Offering
item.description: Indonesian miner PT Merdeka Gold Resources plans to raise about $559 million through a share sale, embarking on a major capital increase at a chaotic time for local markets.

item.title: Nickel Extends Rebound on Prospect of Indonesian Production Cuts
item.description: Nickel rose for a fourth day as the prospect of coordinated output cuts by Chinese producers in Indonesia raised expectations of tighter supply.

item.description: Passive investing is designed to track the market. But what happens when it starts to dominate it?
